Recorded claim:
A later Patch Update review retained the mixed-state child-derived toggle and disabled-selected-child regression coverage because the reported selection problem could not be reproduced. Remove the conflicting `border` override from the Account Hub input part while preserving state backgrounds; use shared `button button-primary` rather than Account Hub-only classes in the reusable template; assign `ariaControlsElements` from the existing `inputs` snapshot; restore `.gecko_rev.yml` `GECKO_HEAD_REF: default`; and name `select-all-total-count` in the Fluent comment. The literal RGBA shadow remains an unresolved design question, not a source conclusion; focused runtime tests were blocked by `CLOBBER`. [Task 1] [ad-hoc note]
